firm_data.firm_description: Coviello Weber & Dahill LLP is a Chambers-ranked boutique law firm offering cost-efficient legal solutions. They focus on corporate, litigation, and employment law, providing a personalized approach to each client.
notable_facts: Founded in 2022 by Gerald and Jeff Coviello, William Dahill, and Paul Weber
Located in The Exchange at Westchester, White Plains, NY
The firm's lawyers are particularly active in securities and investment-related litigation, bankruptcy-related litigation, and partnership and employment-related disputes.

email.subject: AI for Coviello Weber & Dahill - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Gerald,

Since launching Coviello Weber & Dahill in 2022, you've built a Chambers-ranked practice handling complex litigation and corporate work with a lean team. That's exactly the model we see working best with AI.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with smaller teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of boutique practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the Westchester area to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by White Plains on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
